name: Barbell Upright Row
summary: A vertical pull that trains the side delts and upper traps; use a comfortable grip width and range to keep the shoulders happy.
setup: Stand tall holding a barbell with an overhand grip about shoulder width or slightly wider.
Let the bar hang in front of the thighs with arms straight.
Brace the core and keep the ribs down.
Keep the bar close to the body.
execution: Lead with the elbows, pulling the bar up along the torso.
Raise to about chest height; do not go higher if the shoulders feel pinched.
Pause briefly, then lower under control.
mistakes: Pulling too high with elbows far above the hands: stop at about chest height.
Using body momentum: reduce load and stay still.
Grip too narrow causing wrist or shoulder discomfort: widen the grip.
Shrugging excessively: lead with the elbows, not the traps.
